name: Heroes' Vigil
summary: On Stone Cairn Lake's island, Heroes' Vigil lies neglected and overrun by renegade wizards. The Stone of Remembrance honors those who fell in the First War.

sections.title: A Forgotten Memorial
sections.body: Heroes' Vigil gathers around the Stone of Remembrance on an island in Stone Cairn Lake. Erected after the First War, its inscribed circle honors the soldiers and citizens slain when the Old Horde sacked Goldshire and the surrounding valleys. Once a sacred place of faith and sacrifice, the memorial has slipped from Stormwind's attention. Its grounds are overgrown, and no soldiers tend them.

sections.title: Claimed by Renegades
sections.body: Without a kingdom garrison, outcasts have claimed the island. Rogue wizards control Stone Cairn Lake and the memorial grounds. They practice wild, undisciplined magic beyond the oversight of the Kirin Tor and the Academy of Arcane Sciences. Near the stones lies Henze Faulk's body among other tragic casualties. Travelers can only wonder whether the shrine will know peace again.

faq.answer: Heroes' Vigil stands on an island in Stone Cairn Lake in eastern Elwynn Forest. Its stone ring and memorial honor those who fell in the First War.

faq.q: What does the Stone of Remembrance commemorate?
aliases: what is the stone of remembrance
faq.answer: The Stone of Remembrance honors the citizens and defenders who died when the orcish Horde sacked Goldshire and ravaged eastern Elwynn Forest during the First War.
Hostile rogue wizards occupy the island and Heroes' Vigil. They act beyond Stormwind's law and the oversight of established magical institutions.

faq.q: Why has Stormwind neglected the vigil?
faq.answer: Stormwind has left the vigil undefended and largely forgotten because King Varian Wrynn is missing and the realm is stretched thin by internal dissent, brigands, and monster incursions. Remote shrines have been left without protection.

aliases: who is the dead guy on the island
faq.answer: Henze Faulk is a dwarf whose body lies near the monument. Defias Brotherhood forces struck him down while he was saving his friend, Gazin Tenorm.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you see this sacred stone ring as a bitter reminder of the First War's blood price and the kingdom's failure to protect its heritage.
As a mage, you find renegade wizards on sacred ground, practicing dangerous arts without the discipline or sanction of the Academy of Arcane Sciences.
